exercises.name: Cable curl
steps: Keep elbows near your sides; avoid torso swing.
exercises.why: Stable setup and easy load increments

exercises.name: Machine preacher curl
steps: Align elbows with the machine pivot; do not force lockout.

exercises.name: Incline dumbbell curl
steps: Keep upper arms still and lower under control.

exercises.name: EZ-bar curl
steps: Keep wrists aligned and avoid leaning back.
exercises.why: Convenient bilateral loading with angled grip

exercises.name: Dumbbell preacher curl
steps: Keep the upper arm on the pad; use a comfortable range.

exercises.name: Behind-body cable curl
steps: Keep the upper arm slightly behind you; do not pull the shoulder forward.
exercises.why: Cable curl with the shoulder extended

exercises.name: Standing dumbbell curl
steps: Turn palms upward and avoid swinging.
exercises.why: Accessible and allows each arm to work independently

exercises.name: Hammer curl
steps: Keep thumbs up and elbows still.

exercises.name: Concentration curl
steps: Brace the upper arm against the inner thigh; avoid twisting.

exercises.name: Assisted chin-up
steps: Use a palms-up grip; pull without kicking.
exercises.why: Adds biceps work through a compound pull

exercises.name: Overhead cable triceps extension
steps: Keep ribs down and upper arms steady.
exercises.why: Adds triceps work with the shoulder overhead

exercises.name: Cable rope pushdown
steps: Keep elbows at your sides; straighten elbows without swinging.

exercises.name: Machine triceps extension
steps: Align elbow joints with the pivot; control the return.

exercises.name: Straight-bar cable pushdown
steps: Keep shoulders still and wrists aligned.

exercises.name: Single-arm cable pushdown
steps: Keep the elbow close to your side.
exercises.why: Independent loading and comfortable grip choice

exercises.name: Close-grip Smith bench press
steps: Use roughly shoulder-width grip; keep forearms aligned.
exercises.why: Stable compound option for heavier triceps loading

exercises.name: Lying EZ-bar triceps extension
steps: Move through the elbows; lower carefully near the head.

exercises.name: Seated overhead dumbbell extension
steps: Keep elbows reasonably narrow and avoid arching the back.
exercises.why: Overhead alternative when cables are busy

exercises.name: Assisted dip
steps: Use a comfortable shoulder depth; avoid dropping into the bottom.
Use modest forward lean and pain-free shoulder depth.

exercises.name: Cable triceps kickback
steps: Fix the upper arm; extend the elbow without moving the shoulder.
exercises.why: Adds elbow extension with upper arm behind torso

exercises.name: Dumbbell hammer curl
steps: Keep thumbs up and avoid swinging.

exercises.name: EZ-bar reverse curl
steps: Keep palms down and wrists straight.

exercises.name: Seated dumbbell wrist curl
steps: Rest forearms on thighs; move only through the wrists.

exercises.name: Seated dumbbell reverse wrist curl
steps: Use light loads; rest forearms on thighs and lift knuckles.

exercises.name: Farmer carry
steps: Stand tall; keep wrists neutral and walk under control.

exercises.name: Heavy dumbbell hold
steps: Hold at your sides without bending the wrists.

exercises.name: Cable wrist curl
steps: Support forearms and curl through a comfortable wrist range.

exercises.name: Cable reverse wrist curl
steps: Keep forearms fixed; start with a light load.

exercises.name: Dumbbell forearm pronation
steps: Support the forearm; slowly rotate palm downward with a short lever.
exercises.safety: Use a very light load and short lever; do not force wrist/elbow rotation.
exercises.why: Adds rotation missing from curl-only lists

exercises.name: Dumbbell forearm supination
steps: Support the forearm; slowly rotate palm upward with a short lever.
exercises.safety: Use a very light load and short lever; do not force wrist/elbow rotation.

exercises.name: Leg press
steps: Keep pelvis against the pad; use a depth you can control.
Use controlled hip flexion without rounding pelvis off the pad.

exercises.name: Seated leg curl
steps: Align knees with the pivot and keep hips down.
exercises.why: Direct knee-flexion work in a hip-flexed position

exercises.name: Smith squat
steps: Choose a stance that permits controlled depth and stable feet.
Use controlled, comfortable depth; keep whole feet planted.
exercises.why: Loadable squat with a guided bar path

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
steps: Push hips back; keep weights close and spine steady.
Hinge at hips with soft knees; keep weights close.
Keep spine steady and weights close; stop before back rounds.
exercises.safety: Equipment availability varies by gym. Not a back-pain treatment. Many options train spinal bracing rather than dynamic lumbar extension.
exercises.why: Adds hip-hinge work alongside knee-flexion exercises

exercises.name: Leg extension
steps: Align knees with the pivot; avoid kicking the weight.

exercises.name: Hack squat
steps: Keep back on the pad and knees tracking with toes.
exercises.safety: Equipment availability varies by gym. Dedicated machine may be absent at your gym.

exercises.name: Dumbbell split squat
steps: Lower vertically with front foot flat; use support if needed.
Use a comfortable stride; keep pelvis level.
exercises.why: Unilateral thigh loading with feet planted

exercises.name: Lying leg curl
steps: Keep hips against the pad and lower slowly.

exercises.name: Dumbbell reverse lunge
steps: Step back under control; keep the front foot planted.
exercises.why: Unilateral option with a backward step

exercises.name: Hip adduction machine
steps: Use a comfortable opening width; avoid forcing the stretch.
exercises.why: Includes inner-thigh work rather than only quads and hamstrings

exercises.name: Smith hip thrust
steps: Keep ribs down; finish with hips extended, not back arched.

exercises.name: Cable glute kickback
steps: Move from the hip; do not arch the lower back.

exercises.name: Hip abduction machine
steps: Keep pelvis stable; open knees without bouncing.
exercises.why: Adds lateral-hip work to hip-extension exercises

exercises.name: Dumbbell step-up
steps: Drive through the top foot; minimize push-off from the trailing leg.
exercises.why: Unilateral exercise with scalable step height

exercises.name: Cable pull-through
steps: Push hips back; stand tall without leaning backward.
Maintain a steady spine while hips move back and forward.
exercises.safety: Equipment availability varies by gym. Not a back-pain treatment. Many options train spinal bracing rather than dynamic lumbar extension.

exercises.name: Standing cable hip abduction
steps: Keep pelvis level; move leg sideways without leaning.

exercises.name: Standing calf raise machine
steps: Keep knees nearly straight; lower and lift heels without bouncing.
exercises.safety: Calf variations overlap; choose a straight-knee and a bent-knee option, not all 10. Dedicated machine may be absent at your gym.

exercises.name: Seated calf raise machine
steps: Keep knees bent; move through the ankles under control.
exercises.safety: Calf variations overlap; choose a straight-knee and a bent-knee option, not all 10. Dedicated machine may be absent at your gym.

exercises.name: Leg press calf raise
steps: Keep forefeet securely supported; do not unlock the sled unsafely.
exercises.safety: Calf variations overlap; choose a straight-knee and a bent-knee option, not all 10. Use only if the machine permits a secure calf-raise setup.

exercises.name: Smith standing calf raise
steps: Set safeties; use a stable platform and controlled heel travel.
exercises.safety: Calf variations overlap; choose a straight-knee and a bent-knee option, not all 10.
exercises.why: Guided-bar alternative to a dedicated machine

exercises.name: Supported single-leg dumbbell calf raise
steps: Hold support; move through the ankle without rocking.
exercises.safety: Calf variations overlap; choose a straight-knee and a bent-knee option, not all 10.

exercises.name: Seated dumbbell calf raise
steps: Place padded weights near the knees; lift heels slowly.
exercises.safety: Calf variations overlap; choose a straight-knee and a bent-knee option, not all 10.
exercises.why: Bent-knee option without a dedicated machine

exercises.name: Standing dumbbell calf raise
steps: Keep balance stable; avoid knee pumping.
exercises.safety: Calf variations overlap; choose a straight-knee and a bent-knee option, not all 10.

exercises.name: Single-leg seated dumbbell calf raise
steps: Keep knee bent and forefoot planted; control the descent.
exercises.safety: Calf variations overlap; choose a straight-knee and a bent-knee option, not all 10.

exercises.name: Single-leg leg press calf raise
steps: Use a light load; secure foot position and follow machine instructions.
exercises.safety: Calf variations overlap; choose a straight-knee and a bent-knee option, not all 10. Use only if the machine permits a secure calf-raise setup.

exercises.name: Supported bodyweight calf raise
steps: Use hand support; pause at the top and lower slowly.
exercises.safety: Calf variations overlap; choose a straight-knee and a bent-knee option, not all 10.

exercises.name: Seated lumbar extension machine
steps: Set pads correctly; use a small comfortable range without jerking.
exercises.safety: Not a back-pain treatment. Many options train spinal bracing rather than dynamic lumbar extension. Dedicated machine may be absent at your gym.
exercises.why: Most directly targeted option when the machine fixes the pelvis

exercises.name: 45-degree back extension
steps: Hinge at hips with a steady spine; stop at body alignment.
exercises.safety: Not a back-pain treatment. Many options train spinal bracing rather than dynamic lumbar extension.

exercises.name: Smith Romanian deadlift
steps: Keep bar close; adjust stance to the fixed path.
exercises.safety: Not a back-pain treatment. Many options train spinal bracing rather than dynamic lumbar extension.
exercises.target: Erector spinae stabilize; glutes; hamstrings drive

exercises.name: Barbell Romanian deadlift
steps: Push hips back with soft knees; avoid chasing floor depth.
exercises.safety: Not a back-pain treatment. Many options train spinal bracing rather than dynamic lumbar extension.
exercises.target: Erector spinae stabilize; glutes; hamstrings drive

exercises.name: Trap-bar deadlift
steps: Brace before lifting; stand up without leaning backward.
exercises.safety: Not a back-pain treatment. Many options train spinal bracing rather than dynamic lumbar extension. Trap bar may not be available at Planet Fitness.

exercises.name: Barbell good morning
steps: Start very light; brace and hinge without spinal rounding.
exercises.safety: Not a back-pain treatment. Many options train spinal bracing rather than dynamic lumbar extension. Advanced technique; optional, not a beginner default.
exercises.target: Erector spinae stabilize; glutes; hamstrings drive

exercises.name: Suitcase carry
steps: Stay upright; avoid leaning toward or away from the weight.
exercises.safety: Not a back-pain treatment. Many options train spinal bracing rather than dynamic lumbar extension.

exercises.name: Supported single-leg dumbbell Romanian deadlift
steps: Keep hips square and spine steady; use support for balance.
exercises.safety: Not a back-pain treatment. Many options train spinal bracing rather than dynamic lumbar extension.
exercises.target: Erector spinae stabilize; glutes; hamstrings drive

exercises.name: Chest-supported dumbbell row
steps: Keep chest on bench and draw elbows back under control.

exercises.name: Seated cable row
steps: Keep torso steady; pull without excessive backward lean.
exercises.why: Stable horizontal pulling with easy load changes

exercises.name: Machine row
steps: Adjust seat and chest pad; avoid shrugging every repetition.

exercises.name: Lat pulldown
steps: Pull toward upper chest; avoid behind-neck pulling.
exercises.target: Lats; teres major; lower traps assist
exercises.why: Adds vertical pulling to back coverage

exercises.name: Assisted pull-up
steps: Use assistance that allows controlled reps without swinging.

exercises.name: Reverse pec deck
steps: Keep chest supported; open arms without jerking.
Keep chest on pad and move arms without jerking.

exercises.name: Cable face pull
steps: Pull toward eye level; keep ribs down and load moderate.
Pull toward eye level with controlled shoulder rotation.
exercises.target: Rear delts; middle/lower traps; external rotators

exercises.name: One-arm dumbbell row
steps: Keep torso stable; pull elbow back without twisting.

exercises.name: Dumbbell shrug
steps: Lift shoulders straight upward; do not roll them.

exercises.name: Incline dumbbell Y-raise
steps: Use light weights; lift arms in a Y without arching the back.

exercises.name: Cable lateral raise
steps: Raise in a comfortable slightly forward plane; avoid shrugging.

exercises.name: Machine shoulder press
steps: Set seat for comfortable handles; avoid excessive back arch.
exercises.why: Stable overhead press with easy progression

exercises.name: Dumbbell lateral raise
steps: Use soft elbows; stop at a comfortable height without swinging.

exercises.name: Seated dumbbell shoulder press
steps: Use a comfortable grip and keep ribs down.

exercises.name: Cable rear-delt fly
steps: Keep a slight elbow bend; open arms without torso rotation.

exercises.name: Machine lateral raise
steps: Align seat/pads with machine instructions; avoid bouncing.
exercises.safety: Equipment availability varies by gym. Dedicated machine may be absent at your gym.

exercises.name: Smith overhead press
steps: Set safeties and seat position; avoid behind-neck pressing.

exercises.name: Cable front raise
steps: Raise forward without leaning back; often redundant with presses.

exercises.name: Machine chest press
steps: Set handles near mid-chest; keep shoulders comfortable against pad.

exercises.name: Incline dumbbell press
steps: Use a moderate incline and controlled lowering.

exercises.name: Flat dumbbell bench press
steps: Keep wrists over elbows and shoulders stable.

exercises.name: Smith flat bench press
steps: Set safeties; position bench for a comfortable bar path.

exercises.name: Pec deck fly
steps: Avoid forcing a deep shoulder stretch; bring arms together smoothly.

exercises.name: Standing cable chest fly
steps: Keep elbows slightly bent; bring arms together without rocking.

exercises.name: Incline machine chest press
steps: Set seat for comfortable pressing; avoid shrugging.

exercises.name: Smith incline bench press
steps: Set safeties; use a moderate incline and comfortable depth.

exercises.name: Low-to-high cable fly
steps: Sweep hands upward and inward without leaning back.
exercises.why: Upward fly path for upper-chest variety

exercises.name: Seated abdominal crunch machine
steps: Curl ribs toward pelvis; avoid pulling only with the arms.
exercises.safety: All core entries use machines/cables. Variants overlap; this is a menu, not one workout.

exercises.name: Kneeling cable crunch
steps: Round through the trunk gently; do not just hinge at the hips.
exercises.safety: All core entries use machines/cables. Variants overlap; this is a menu, not one workout.

exercises.name: Standing cable Pallof press
steps: Stand side-on; press hands forward without rotating torso.
exercises.safety: All core entries use machines/cables. Variants overlap; this is a menu, not one workout.

exercises.name: Standing cable crunch
steps: Draw ribs toward pelvis rather than folding only at hips.
exercises.safety: All core entries use machines/cables. Variants overlap; this is a menu, not one workout.

exercises.name: Seated cable crunch
steps: Keep hips steady and curl the rib cage toward pelvis.
exercises.safety: All core entries use machines/cables. Variants overlap; this is a menu, not one workout.

exercises.name: High-to-low cable chop
steps: Turn through hips and trunk together; avoid wrenching the low back.
exercises.safety: All core entries use machines/cables. Variants overlap; this is a menu, not one workout.

exercises.name: Low-to-high cable lift
steps: Use light load and controlled hip/trunk rotation.
exercises.safety: All core entries use machines/cables. Variants overlap; this is a menu, not one workout.
exercises.why: Opposite diagonal to the cable chop

exercises.name: Cable side bend
steps: Use a small comfortable range without rotating.
exercises.safety: All core entries use machines/cables. Variants overlap; this is a menu, not one workout.

exercises.name: Torso rotation machine
steps: Align machine settings; keep range modest and avoid forcing end positions.
exercises.safety: All core entries use machines/cables. Variants overlap; this is a menu, not one workout. Skip if rotation causes back discomfort.

exercises.name: Cable Pallof hold
steps: Hold arms extended; breathe while keeping torso square.
exercises.safety: All core entries use machines/cables. Variants overlap; this is a menu, not one workout.
exercises.why: Static anti-rotation alternative to press repetitions
